Coverage_Description: Dental network cover for preventive, basic, complex, and accidental treatments with annual limits HK$5,000/HK$2,000/HK$5,000/HK$5,000 and copay 0%/20%/50%/0%; 10% discount on eligible excess charges at designated clinics
customer requirement: HKID holder and Hong Kong residential address required for both policyholder and insured; purchase in Hong Kong SAR only
additional informations: Compassionate death benefit HK$5,000; 30-day grace period for overdue premium
